# Changelog

The **canonical changelog is [`CHANGELOG.md` in the repository root](https://github.com/acamarata/cascade/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)**, and every
release is also published on the
[Releases page](https://github.com/acamarata/cascade/releases).

## Why this page is an index, not a copy

This page used to hold a hand-maintained duplicate of the changelog. It drifted:
it sat on an unreleased P2 section listing the macOS widget work while the
project shipped through v1.16.0, so a reader arriving here got a version history
that was dozens of releases out of date and silently wrong about what Cascade
could do.

A second hand-written copy of a file that changes on every release will always
drift. This page is therefore an index into the canonical source rather than a
mirror of it: the table below is generated from the released sections of the
root changelog, and the entries themselves live in one place.
